boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named SUNY Maritime destinations for studying, campus activities, waterfront learning, athletics, and maritime history.

cards.title: Stephen B. Luce Library
cards.subtitle: Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Start with the catalog or ask for research support, then use the library’s print, digital, and archival maritime collections for a focused work session.
cards.short_summary: A campus research hub with specialized maritime collections and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime identifies Stephen B. Luce Library as its academic library and says it provides digital resources, special collections, research support, and maritime-focused collections.
cards.source_title: Stephen B. Luce Library | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Library access and services are intended for the campus community; confirm current hours and visitor access before going.

cards.title: Maritime Industry Museum
cards.subtitle: Fort Schuyler
cards.notes: Take the self-guided route through ship models, artifacts, and interactive displays; check the museum page before visiting for current access details.
cards.short_summary: A maritime-history museum housed inside the college’s historic fort.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the Maritime Industry Museum is housed in historic Fort Schuyler on campus and features interactive and multimedia displays, maritime art, and artifacts.
cards.source_title: Maritime Industry Museum | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: The museum states that admission and parking are free; its published visiting hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Fort Schuyler
cards.subtitle: Historic campus centerpiece
cards.notes: Walk the fort exterior and museum approach as a history-oriented campus stop, keeping clear of classrooms and any posted restricted areas.
cards.short_summary: The historic fort that became SUNY Maritime’s permanent land base.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s history page states that the academy came ashore at Fort Schuyler in 1938 and that the fort remains the cornerstone of the college campus.
cards.source_title: Fort Schuyler History | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Fort Schuyler contains college and museum spaces; follow campus and museum access guidance.

cards.title: SUNY Maritime Waterfront
cards.subtitle: Campus waterfront
cards.notes: Use the waterfront as a daytime campus stop to watch organized rowing or sailing activity from permitted shore-side areas; do not enter docks or boats uninvited.
cards.short_summary: The campus waterfront supports maritime training, rowing, sailing, and kayaking activities.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says its waterfront supports lifeboat practice, training-ship preparation, rowing, sailing, kayaking, and other boat activity.
cards.access_notes: Waterfront programs and vessel access can be supervised or scheduled; use only permitted shore-side areas unless enrolled or invited.

cards.title: Maritime Academic Center
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination
cards.notes: Meet between classes in the building’s shared areas or use it as a landmark for scheduled lectures, meetings, and academic events.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed academic building with classrooms and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists the Maritime Academic Center, and its facilities page documents classrooms and a multi-purpose room there.
cards.source_title: Conference and Meeting Rentals | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Classrooms and event rooms may be scheduled; use common areas only when open and respect posted event access.

cards.title: Riesenberg Gymnasium and Swimming Pool
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination
cards.notes: Check athletics or recreation schedules before heading over, then use the named gym-and-pool complex only during its approved student access periods.
cards.short_summary: A campus map-listed gymnasium and swimming-pool complex.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map identifies Riesenberg Gymnasium and Swimming Pool as a named campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and pool use may be scheduled or limited to authorized users; confirm current recreation rules.

cards.title: Vander Clute Hall
cards.subtitle: Mess Deck and Special Events Room
cards.notes: Use this map-listed hall as a campus meal or event waypoint, and check the current dining or event schedule before making a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: The building that the campus map identifies with the Mess Deck and Special Events Room.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists Vander Clute Hall and identifies the Mess Deck and Special Events Room there.
cards.access_notes: Dining and event spaces can have scheduled service or reserved use; verify current access before arrival.

cards.title: Olivet Pier
cards.subtitle: Campus waterfront map destination
cards.notes: Locate Olivet Pier on the campus map, then enjoy the surrounding permitted waterfront views without entering the pier or vessel areas unless authorized.
cards.short_summary: A named pier on SUNY Maritime’s waterfront campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map labels Olivet Pier as a named destination near the Maritime Academic Center and waterfront facilities.
cards.access_notes: Pier and dock areas may have operational or safety restrictions; view from permitted public campus areas unless authorized.

cards.title: Reinhart Athletic Field
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find the field, then check the athletics calendar for a scheduled game or support event before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic field on the SUNY Maritime campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map identifies Reinhart Athletic Field as a named campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Field access may be reserved for practices, games, or campus operations; follow posted rules and event directions.

cards.title: Reinhart Baseball Field
cards.subtitle: Campus map destination
cards.notes: Find the baseball field via the campus map and pair a visit with an officially scheduled athletics event when the facility is open to spectators.
cards.short_summary: A separate named baseball field on the waterfront-side campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map identifies Reinhart Baseball Field as a named campus destination distinct from Reinhart Athletic Field.
cards.access_notes: Facility access may be limited to scheduled athletics activity; verify spectator and campus access before visiting.
